primary.sql: SELECT a.account_id AS key, a.available_balance - coalesce(t.net, 0) AS value, coalesce(t.n, 0) AS count FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, sum(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'credit' THEN transaction_amount ELSE -transaction_amount END) AS net, count(*) AS n FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id) t USING (account_id) WHERE abs(a.available_balance - coalesce(t.net, 0)) > 0.005 ORDER BY abs(value) DESC
